evidence_quote: This study investigated Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection prevalence and disease-related knowledge among spouses of reported HBV cases in Quzhou City to support family-based interventions reducing intra-familial transmission.
rationale: The study focuses on HBV prevalence, health knowledge, and household transmission prevention. It does not address brain or neural mechanisms, neurological disease, cognition, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
